thread:
Alex Kim: Taking over primary for the next 12h. Primary=Alex, Secondary=Maria. Quick heads up — embeddings-relay in eu-west-1 has been showing elevated error rates and 95th pct latency since ~03:40 UTC. I saw the incident-bot page earlier.

incident-bot: ALERT: embeddings-relay-high-error-rate — Severity: P2 — triggered at 2026-03-15T03:40:12Z. Symptoms: 5xx spike, KV-cache thrash. Pager routed to eng-oncall primary.

Maria Ortega: Ack, I'm secondary and will monitor. Do we have a mitigation in-flight?

Alex Kim: Short answer: yes — Jamal started a temporary routing rule to divert autocomplete traffic to us-west-2 to reduce load on eu-west-1. It lowered traffic by ~28% but errors persist on a few model routes. I added a tiny autoscale bump for the relay pool (manual) to tide us over.

Jamal Singh: Confirmed the divert at 03:52Z: `kubectl apply -f routing-shift-eu-to-us.yaml` — logs show proxy accepted new route. Also kicked off a cache warm-up job: `scripts/kv_warmup --region eu-west-1 --shards 4`.

Maria Ortega: Nice. Any customer-facing impact? Should we open a status page incident?

Alex Kim: So far we've seen increased 5xx for a small subset of enterprise customers using long-context embeddings. Affects throughput, not accuracy. I think we should file a status incident with a limited scope note. Jamal can you paste a short mitigation summary for the incident ticket?

Jamal Singh: Pasting: "Applied partial traffic shift to us-west-2 for non-EU legal jurisdictions; manually resized relay pool in eu-west-1 (+2 nodes) and kicked cache warm-up. Observed error-rate drop from 6.3% -> 3.9% in 20m. Root cause suspected: KV cache eviction storm on a shard. Continued observation needed"

SRE Pager: New ticket created: INC-4125 — embeddings-relay elevated errors (eu-west-1). Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4125

Maria Ortega: I'll take ownership of follow-up post-handoff. Action items: 1) Confirm KV cache eviction thresholds, 2) run deeper heap/profile on relay nodes, 3) scope customer list impacted for comms. I'll open runbook tasks in the ticket.

Alex Kim: Good plan. Runbook pointer for anyone needing quick steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-relay — see 'Mitigation: divert traffic' and 'KV cache recovery'.

Jamal Singh: Noted weirdness in metrics: a single shard accounted for ~70% of the 5xx—could be corrupted index entry. I created a followup internal bug: BUG-2892 and attached heap dumps to the ticket.

Maria Ortega: Scheduling a short retro tomorrow 09:30 PDT to review what triggered the shard thrash and whether our cache TTL/eviction heuristics need changes. I'll invite infra, runtime, and SRE.

Alex Kim: Post-handoff summary for the new shift (cc @SRE Pager): Primary=Alex (until 15:30 PDT), Secondary=Maria. Open items: INC-4125 (monitor + comms), BUG-2892 (investigate shard corruption), deploy a safer autoscale config (followup PR needed).

Alex Kim: If anyone gets paged, escalate to me -> Maria. Leaving a short checklist: `- monitor: grafana/dashboards/emb-relay-eu` `- mitigation: routing-shift manifest` `- comms: INC-4125 update every 30m until stable`. :thumbsup:

SRE Pager: Note added to INC-4125: next update due in 30m.

Maria Ortega: I'm on it. Will update INC-4125 with customer list and a postmortem invite. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

Alex Kim: Thanks — handing off now.
